content: The chapter says Ulugh Beg was constrained by the prevailing political atmosphere of Shāhrukhid Iran, which featured the persecution of lettrists like Ibn Turka on the pretext of association with the anarchic Ḥurūfiyya, to be more modest and conservative in presenting his project.
refers_to_primary: Binbas, The Anatomy of a Regicide Attempt; MK dissertation ch. 8
